brief:
An analyst has compared Israeli mainstream media rhetoric to Radio Rwanda's role in inciting the 1994 genocide, according to Middle East Eye. Ameer Fakhoury said racist targeting of Palestinian citizens of Israel has reached dangerous and unprecedented levels, signaling deeper societal fractures.

Fakhoury's comparison reflects growing concern about inflammatory language in Israeli media coverage of Palestinians and tensions within Israeli society.

title: Israeli analyst warns media rhetoric mirrors genocide incitement
